suite.label: Benchmark
suite.tip: A set of tasks the agent is tested on.

task.label: Task
task.tip: One job the agent must do, checked automatically.

admitted.label: Ready
admitted.tip: A correct solution passes and a do-nothing agent fails.

admission.label: Readiness check
admission.tip: Checks a correct solution passes and a do-nothing agent fails.

draft.label: Not ready
draft.tip: Failed the readiness check. Not used in tests.

locked.label: Frozen
locked.tip: Tasks are pinned. Every run sees the same version.

probe.label: Failure test
probe.tip: A fault added to the tasks, like a model outage.

tier.label: Difficulty level
tier.tip: How hard the tasks are. Higher levels add failure tests.

experiment.label: Comparison
experiment.tip: Runs setups A and B on the same tasks.

armA.label: Setup A (baseline)
armA.tip: The setup you have today. Setup B is compared against it.

armB.label: Setup B (candidate)
armB.tip: The new setup you want to try. It is compared against Setup A.

verdict.label: Result
verdict.tip: What the comparison concluded: B is better, B is worse, no clear winner yet, or the test was broken.

inconclusive.label: No clear winner yet
inconclusive.tip: Not enough evidence. Run more tasks.

invalid.label: Test was broken
invalid.tip: Measuring failed through no fault of the agent. Fix and re-check.

score.label: Scored
score.tip: One setup scored alone, with a 95% range. No comparison.

improved.label: B is better
improved.tip: Setup B solved clearly more tasks than Setup A.

regressed.label: B is worse
regressed.tip: Setup B solved clearly fewer tasks than Setup A.

run.label: Run
run.tip: One attempt by one agent at one task.

sealed.label: Saved and locked
sealed.tip: Stored with a fingerprint. Any later change is detected.

manifest.label: Test recipe (fingerprint)
manifest.tip: The exact settings of this comparison, fingerprinted.

grades.label: Scores / Re-score
grades.tip: The grader's marks per run. Re-score grades saved work again.

gate.label: Safety check
gate.tip: A rule that fails a run that cheated or did something unsafe.

guard.label: Safety rule
guard.tip: A rule that watches what the agent does and stops or flags unsafe actions.

integrityViolation.label: Cheating or unsafe action detected
integrityViolation.tip: The agent cheated or acted unsafely. The run fails.

abortedInfra.label: Infrastructure error (not counted)
abortedInfra.tip: The run broke before the agent started. It is retried.

verifier.label: Grader / hidden checks
verifier.tip: Hidden tests that decide if the task is solved.

flakyVerifier.label: Unreliable grader
flakyVerifier.tip: The grader gave different answers for the same work.

meters.label: Measurements
meters.tip: Per-run numbers like cost, time, steps and tokens.

diagnostics.label: Details by fault
diagnostics.tip: The same results split into the normal run and each failure test.

conditionClean.label: Normal run
conditionClean.tip: The tasks as written, with no failure test added.

stats.label: Significance
stats.tip: Chance the gap is luck, and the smallest gap these tasks can show.

canary.label: Drift monitor
canary.tip: A small scheduled test that catches an agent or model getting worse.

inbox.label: Production failures
inbox.tip: Failures from production, waiting to become tasks.

traceSource.label: Where failures come from
traceSource.tip: A system that sends failed agent sessions into Production failures.

livescore.label: Live quality scoring
livescore.tip: Scores production agent sessions as they happen.

runner.label: Worker / shared worker
runner.tip: A machine that runs the agents.

lease.label: Claim on a worker
lease.tip: Internal record of which worker runs which task.

policy.label: Release rule
policy.tip: A rule a new agent version must pass before it can be released.

release.label: Release record
release.tip: A saved record that an agent version shipped, with the evidence behind it.

calibration.label: Grader accuracy check
calibration.tip: Compares the grader's marks with human marks to see how often it is right.

synthetic.label: Practice mode (no real model, free)
synthetic.tip: Scripted model, free, results not real. Not on the hosted site.

oracle.label: Perfect reference agent
oracle.tip: Applies the known solution to check a task is solvable.

noop.label: Do-nothing agent
noop.tip: Does nothing, to check a task cannot pass for free.

capabilities.label: Skills tested
capabilities.tip: The kinds of ability a benchmark checks, such as coding, browsing or tool use.

license.label: License
license.tip: The terms under which the tasks may be used and shared.
